subtitle: Lesson 19 · Regulatory Compliance Frameworks

code:
SOC 2 / ISO 27001
  adopted VOLUNTARILY to demonstrate trustworthiness

PCI DSS / HIPAA
  apply BECAUSE of what data you actually handle
  - cardholder data  -> PCI DSS
  - protected health information (PHI) -> HIPAA
  not an opt-in attestation
caption: Getting applicability wrong in either direction is expensive — a real violation, or wasted spend.

steps.label: CDE
steps.sub: people, process, and tech that store, process, or transmit cardholder data

steps.label: Scope reduction
steps.sub: route checkout through a validated processor so your systems never see raw PANs

code:
Covered entity
  health plan / clearinghouse / provider

Business associate
  vendor that creates, receives, maintains, or
  transmits PHI on behalf of a covered entity

Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
  the required contract that turns the relationship
  into a HIPAA obligation
caption: A business associate handling PHI without a signed BAA is a serious, sanctionable gap.
